description: We are a team of five enthusiastic students from Vikash Residential School, Bhubaneswar, passionate about space science, technology, creativity, and innovation. We are participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to develop an interactive Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer that makes Mars survival learning fun and engaging. Our team combines curiosity, teamwork, problem-solving, and a passion for exploration.
summary:
Project Description: Pico – The Martian Survivor

Pico: The Martian Survivor is an interactive, cross-platform Mars exploration and survival game designed to introduce players to the challenges of planetary exploration.

The project follows Pico, a young astronaut stranded on Mars after an unexpected spacecraft malfunction during a scientific expedition. Players control Pico as he explores an open-world Martian environment, navigates challenging terrains, discovers underground locations, collects essential resources, and overcomes survival obstacles.

The primary objective is to help Pico restore his damaged spacecraft and independently launch from Mars to return safely.

The game combines exploration, resource management, problem-solving, and interactive storytelling. It supports both desktop and mobile platforms, featuring keyboard controls and touchscreen-based movement.

The project aims to promote scientific curiosity, introduce fundamental concepts of space exploration, and make planetary exploration more engaging and accessible through interactive digital technology.
details:
Our project, Pico: The Martian Survivor, is an interactive Mars exploration and survival game. It follows Pico, a young astronaut stranded on Mars after an unexpected spacecraft malfunction. Players control Pico as he explores the Martian environment, collects resources, manages survival requirements, discovers underground locations, overcomes challenges, and repairs his spacecraft to return safely from Mars.

The project aims to promote scientific curiosity, creativity, problem-solving skills, and awareness of the challenges associated with planetary exploration. It provides an engaging way to experience a fictional space mission through interactive gameplay.

The creative aspect lies in combining an original storyline, open-world exploration, survival mechanics, and mission-based progression. The game is designed for both desktop and mobile platforms, with keyboard controls and a virtual joystick for mobile users.

The project was developed with the assistance of OpenCode AI, Lovable, ChatGPT, Blender, and Vercel. These tools supported AI-assisted development, design, 3D modelling, and deployment.

During development, our team considered cross-platform compatibility, user-friendly controls, visual design, accessibility, engaging gameplay, and educational value. Our ultimate goal is to make space exploration more interactive and inspiring for younger generations.
